content: Nashimanica Juan yohuanai
Jascanihbo cahchiqui sca ta tsoa jano yamahiton nashimanica Juan nihpahonishqui, Judea main. Yohuancanahi cahi nihnichi.
—Maton shinan tiromabo jenebahinquin shinan siribo sca bihnahue. Papan mato jihuemati nete ta nea pishca sca jaonahiqui.
Papan joi yohinica Isaíasnen huishaxon yohini quesca ta Juan janishqui.

content.text: Jano tsoa jihuetaitonma tah hen yohuancanahi. Noquen Hihbo hahan jonon bahixonnahue, pontequin bahixonnahue, hih tah hen jai

content: hihqui jaa huisha.
Juaman ta camelo rani chopajaxon sahuepahonishqui. Histon nihnoxon rihbi yohina bichi quexen jahuen tari pishnexehti. Champobo res ta pipahonishqui, champoya bonajene.
Jaa nincaqui sca ta Jerusalen janin jihuetaibo bocannishqui. Judea main jihuetaibo jatihibi, Jordan huean patax jihuetaibo rihbi jaa nincaqui bocani.
Juan yohuanai nincaxon, jaton yorabi yohihi jaton hohchabo yohipaquescacanquin, Juaman jato jeneho hihquimatannon.

Jano jan jato nashimahi janin fariseobo betan saduceobo rihbi hicha hahqui nocohihnati. Nocohihnataibo jisxon, Juaman jato yohiquin: —¡Rono baquebon! ¿Tsoan mato neno jabaquihrani joti yohihaxquin, Papan mato casticanmis hihquish man jonon?
Maton shinan tiromabo potaxon shinan siribo sca bihnahue. Sirijaquin shinanax res sca jihuenahue hih ca hen jahihsen.
Noque caya tah non Abrahanen baquebo qui hihyamaribinahue. ¡Man yohinani jascamis! Abraham baquebo jacatsihquin ta nea man jisi macanbo Papan jonijati hahtipahiqui, Abraham baquebo sca janon.
Jihui reranoxon hahcajaquin ta jahuen yami bihxon Papan tarescaiqui. Bimiyosma jihuibo reraxon mapojaquin hahcajaquin ta tiroma shinanyahpabo Papan casticanscaiqui. Shinannahue.

Maton shinan man pontehiya tah hen jenen res mato nashimahi. Huetsa joni rihbi ta joresscaiqui. Hea mentan hashoan coshi. Jaa hihti siri copi tah hen jahuen sapato boxonti senenyamahi. Jaan ta jahuen yoshin siri mato hinantihiqui. Chihi rihbi ta mato maracantihiqui.

Bimi berobo tsinquixon, chishpo potaquin hahcajaquin ta Papan xecoscaiqui. Jahuen bimi siribo rahsi tsinquixon sca jahuen jano bexojati janin bexojaquin hahcajaquin ta Papan jahuen baquebo tsinquihiqui. Chishpo cahen nocayosma chihin mapojayaxihquiqui —jato jaquin Juaman.
Juaman Jesus jeneho hihquimatanai
Jaatian ta Galilea mai janinhax Jesus noconishqui. Juaman jaa nashimaquin hihquimatannon hihquish, Jordan huean qui jahuí, jano Juaman nashimahi janin.
Hea nashimahue hahca bi Juan queenyamahi. —Mian caya hea nashimahue. ¿Mian hea nashimatihi bi min Hea nashimahue hah min hea jai nan? —hihqui Juan.
—Jaabi hea nashimahue. Min hea nashimati ta Papa queenih qui. Papan yohihi jatihibi hean nincanica hihnon hea nashimascahue —Jesusen jascahah, Juaman jeenhahquin. Jeenhahxon, nashimaquin.
Hueaman nashimaha Jesus mapescai. Jaatian ta nai cohin potabohanahcamahi quehpemehtaiya bochiquihax nobex botopaquetai quescari Dios Yoshin hahqui botopaqueti jahui Jesusen jisnishqui.
Naihoh quehax yohuanai rihbi nincacanquin. —Nea ta hahan hen queenai heen baque qui. Hahan tah hen hihti jenimahi —hihqui.
